const incoming = $json.handoff_payload || $json.precheck_handoff_payload || $json;
const hasIncomingHandoff = incoming && typeof incoming === 'object' && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(incoming, 'precheck_status');
const safeLog = {
  workflow: 'KBIA_03_WF_Upbit_PreCheck_Engine',
  mode: 'dry_run',
  market: 'KRW-BTC',
  side: 'bid',
  ord_type: 'limit',
  system_stop_active: false,
  duplicate_lock_status: 'clear',
  order_size_status: 'clear',
  open_order_telemetry: { open_order_exists: false }
};
const handoff = hasIncomingHandoff ? incoming : {
  market: 'KRW-BTC',
  side: 'bid',
  ord_type: 'limit',
  price: 100000000,
  volume: 0.0001,
  estimated_krw_value: 10000,
  precheck_status: 'dry_run_ready',
  all_pass: true,
  execution_allowed: true,
  execution_mode: 'dry_run',
  live_order_enabled: false,
  one_time_live_attempt_allowed: false,
  duplicate_lock_status: 'clear',
  order_size_status: 'clear',
  open_order_exists: false,
  system_stop_active: false,
  safe_log_payload: safeLog
};
const requestedMode = String(handoff.execution_mode || (handoff.safe_log_payload || {}).mode || 'dry_run');
const liveFlagsExplicit = requestedMode === 'live'
  && handoff.live_order_enabled === true
  && handoff.execution_allowed === true
  && handoff.one_time_live_attempt_allowed === true;
const estimated = Number(handoff.estimated_krw_value || 0);
const price = Number(handoff.price || 100000000);
const volume = Number(handoff.volume || (price > 0 && estimated > 0 ? estimated / price : 0));
const safe = handoff.safe_log_payload || {};
const openOrderExists = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(handoff, 'open_order_exists')
  ? handoff.open_order_exists === true
  : ((safe.open_order_telemetry || {}).open_order_exists === true);
return {
  handoff_payload: handoff,
  handoff_received: true,
  handoff_source: hasIncomingHandoff ? 'input' : 'manual_default_valid_dry_run_handoff',
  handoff_validated: false,
  handoff_rejected_reason: null,
  execution_flow_entered: false,
  entered_execution_flow: false,
  reached_order_preparation: false,
  reached_order_test: false,
  reached_live_order: false,
  reached_dry_run_block: false,
  reached_fail_safe: false,
  reached_log_payload: false,
  helper_base_url: String($json.helper_base_url || 'http://upbit-helper:8010'),
  market: String(handoff.market || 'KRW-BTC'),
  side: String(handoff.side || 'bid'),
  ord_type: String(handoff.ord_type || 'limit'),
  price,
  volume,
  estimated_krw_value: estimated,
  all_pass: handoff.all_pass === true,
  duplicate_lock_status: String(handoff.duplicate_lock_status || ''),
  order_size_status: String(handoff.order_size_status || ''),
  open_order_exists: openOrderExists,
  system_stop_active: handoff.system_stop_active === true,
  requested_execution_mode: requestedMode,
  execution_mode: requestedMode === 'live' ? 'live' : 'dry_run',
  execution_allowed: liveFlagsExplicit,
  live_order_enabled: liveFlagsExplicit,
  one_time_live_attempt_allowed: liveFlagsExplicit,
  live_path_auto_disabled: false,
  no_order_submitted: true,
  reason_codes: []
};

const dryRunPayload = {
  market: String($json.market || 'KRW-BTC'),
  side: String($json.side || 'bid'),
  ord_type: String($json.ord_type || 'limit'),
  estimated_krw_value: Number($json.estimated_krw_value || 0),
  execution_mode: 'dry_run',
  execution_allowed: false,

};
return {

  execution_allowed: false,
  live_order_enabled: false,
  one_time_live_attempt_allowed: false,
  live_path_auto_disabled: $json.live_path_auto_disabled === true,
  reason_codes: [...new Set([...(Array.isArray($json.reason_codes) ? $json.reason_codes : []), 'DRY_RUN_ORDER_BLOCKED'])]
};

return {
  ...$json,
  reached_dry_run_block: true,
  dry_run_blocked: true,
  order_submission_status: 'blocked_before_http',
  order_endpoint_called: false,
  forbidden_endpoint_used: false,
  no_order_submitted: true,
  execution_allowed: false,
  live_order_enabled: false,
  one_time_live_attempt_allowed: false,
  reason_codes: [...new Set([...(Array.isArray($json.reason_codes) ? $json.reason_codes : []), 'DRY_RUN_ORDER_BLOCKED'])]
};

const handoffTrace = {
  handoff_received: $json.handoff_received === true,
  handoff_validated: $json.handoff_validated === true,
  handoff_rejected_reason: $json.handoff_rejected_reason || null,
  execution_flow_entered: $json.execution_flow_entered === true

const executionTrace = {
  ...handoffTrace,
  entered_execution_flow: $json.entered_execution_flow === true,
  reached_order_preparation: $json.reached_order_preparation === true,
  reached_order_test: $json.reached_order_test === true,
  reached_live_order: $json.reached_live_order === true,
  reached_dry_run_block: $json.reached_dry_run_block === true,
  reached_fail_safe: $json.reached_fail_safe === true,
  reached_log_payload: true
};
const dryRunPayload = $json.dry_run_payload || {
  market: String($json.market || 'KRW-BTC'),
  side: String($json.side || 'bid'),
  ord_type: String($json.ord_type || 'limit'),
  estimated_krw_value: Number($json.estimated_krw_value || 0),
  execution_mode: 'dry_run',
  execution_allowed: false,
  live_order_enabled: false,
  dry_run_blocked: true
};
const reasonCodes = [...new Set([...(Array.isArray($json.reason_codes) ? $json.reason_codes : []), ...($json.live_order_attempted === true ? ['LIVE_ATTEMPT_CONSUMED'] : ['DRY_RUN_ORDER_BLOCKED'])])];
const logPayload = {
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  workflow: 'KBIA_04_WF_Upbit_Execution_Engine',
  handoff_trace: handoffTrace,
  execution_trace: executionTrace,
  dry_run_payload: dryRunPayload,
  order_test_telemetry: $json.order_test_telemetry || null,
  live_order_telemetry: $json.live_order_telemetry || null,

  dry_run_blocked: $json.dry_run_blocked === true,
  reason_codes: reasonCodes,
  fail_safe_status: $json.fail_safe_status || 'armed_no_order_submitted',
  order_endpoint_called: $json.live_order_attempted === true,
  forbidden_endpoint_used: false,
  live_order_enabled: false,
  execution_mode: $json.live_order_attempted === true ? 'live_attempt_consumed' : 'dry_run',
  execution_allowed: false
};
return {
  ...$json,
  reached_log_payload: true,
  handoff_trace: handoffTrace,
  execution_trace: executionTrace,
  dry_run_payload: dryRunPayload,
  order_test_telemetry: $json.order_test_telemetry || null,
  order_test_passed: $json.order_test_passed === true,
  live_order_telemetry: $json.live_order_telemetry || null,
  live_order_attempted: $json.live_order_attempted === true,
  live_order_accepted: $json.live_order_accepted === true,
  live_path_auto_disabled: $json.live_path_auto_disabled === true,
  dry_run_blocked: $json.dry_run_blocked === true,
  execution_status: $json.live_order_attempted === true ? 'one_time_live_attempt_consumed' : ($json.handoff_validated === true ? 'valid_handoff_dry_run_blocked' : 'handoff_rejected_dry_run_blocked'),
  reason_codes: reasonCodes,
  execution_log_payload: logPayload,
  fail_safe_trace: {
    reached_fail_safe: true,
    fail_safe_status: $json.fail_safe_status || 'armed_no_order_submitted',
    fail_safe_reason: $json.fail_safe_reason || 'dry_run_order_blocked_before_http'
  },
  execution_allowed: false,
  live_order_enabled: false,
  one_time_live_attempt_allowed: false,
  no_order_submitted: $json.live_order_attempted === true ? false : true
};
